gas.outOfListHint: Stations outside the list are shown with an expression indicating price level only

gas.nationalTop10Main: + rank number (droplet pin) = Nationwide Top 10 lowest prices
gas.nearbyTop10Main: Rank badge = Nearby (10km) Top 10 lowest prices
